svg.title: How the Makefile processes ../LLMTuning/blogs
svg.desc: Vertical flow showing five steps: variable definition, template definition, foreach/eval/call expansion, dependency check, and file copy from the LLMTuning source directory into the Jekyll site.
svg.text: Top-level Makefile holds two rule templates
foreach + eval + call expands templates into concrete rules
After expansion, Make sees a real rule for every stem — for example:
make all walks md_targets and asset_targets, checks timestamps
For each target, is the source newer than the destination? If yes, run the recipe.
Recipe runs: cp from source repo into the Jekyll site
